mapper.select: (SELECT b.pid as pid,b.org_name as orgName,b.identify_type as identifyType,b.unisc_code as uniscCode,r.pid relId,r.rel_category relCategory,r.rel_category_sub relCategorySub,r.rel_status relStatus,r.regulator regulator FROM bus_rel_org b JOIN bus_rel_pro_psnandorg r ON r.from_pid = b.pid WHERE r.from_type = 'ORG' AND r.to_type = 'PRO' AND r.DELFLAG_ = '1' AND r.from_pid = #{pid}) union (SELECT b.pid as pid,b.org_name as orgName,b.identify_type as identifyType,b.unisc_code as uniscCode,r.pid relId,r.rel_category relCategory,r.rel_category_sub relCategorySub,r.rel_status relStatus,r.regulator regulator FROM bus_rel_org b JOIN bus_rel_pro_psnandorg r ON r.to_pid = b.pid WHERE r.from_type = 'PRO' AND r.to_type = 'ORG' AND r.DELFLAG_ = '1' AND r.to_pid = #{pid} )

(SELECT b.name_,b.identify_type identifyType,b.identify_number identifyNumber,b.pid,r.pid relId,r.rel_category relCategory,r.rel_category_sub relCategorySub,r.rel_status relStatus,r.regulator regulator FROM bus_rel_psn b JOIN bus_rel r ON r.from_pid = b.pid WHERE r.from_type = 'PSN' AND r.to_type = 'ORG' AND r.DELFLAG_ = '1' AND r.to_pid = #{pid}) union ( SELECT b.`name`,b.identify_type identifyType,b.identify_number identifyNumber,b.pid,r.pid relId,r.rel_category relCategory,r.rel_category_sub relCategorySub,r.rel_status relStatus,r.regulator regulator FROM bus_rel_psn b JOIN bus_rel r ON r.to_pid = b.pid WHERE r.from_type = 'ORG' AND r.to_type = 'PSN' AND r.DELFLAG_ = '1' AND r.from_pid = #{pid} )

(SELECT b.pid as pid,b.org_name as orgName,b.identify_type as identifyType,b.unisc_code as uniscCode,r.pid relId,r.rel_category relCategory,r.rel_category_sub relCategorySub,r.rel_status relStatus,r.regulator regulator FROM bus_rel_org b JOIN bus_rel r ON r.to_pid = b.pid WHERE r.from_type = 'ORG' AND r.to_type = 'ORG' AND r.DELFLAG_ = '1' AND r.to_pid = #{pid}) union (SELECT b.pid as pid,b.org_name as orgName,b.identify_type as identifyType,b.unisc_code as uniscCode,r.pid relId,r.rel_category relCategory,r.rel_category_sub relCategorySub,r.rel_status relStatus,r.regulator regulator FROM bus_rel_org b JOIN bus_rel r ON r.from_pid = b.pid WHERE r.from_type = 'ORG' AND r.to_type = 'ORG' AND r.DELFLAG_ = '1' AND r.from_pid = #{pid} )

select a.name_ as name, a.residential_address as residentialAddress, a.birthdate, a.identify_type as identifyType, a.identify_number as identifyNumber, a.pid as pid, a.active_time as activeTime, a.invalid_time as invalidTime, b.pid as relId, b.rel_category as relCategory, b.rel_category_sub as relCategorySub, b.isValid as isValid, b.shareholding_ratio as shareholdingRatio, b.relStatement as relStatement, b.rel_status as relStatus, b.pledge_ratio as pledgeRatio from bus_rel_psn a join (select from_pid, from_name, rel_category, rel_category_sub, isValid, rel_status, pid, shareholding_ratio, relStatement, effectiveDate, ineffectiveDate, pledge_ratio from bus_rel where to_pid = #{orgid} and to_type = 'ORG' and from_type = 'PSN' and DELFLAG_ = '1') b on a.pid = b.from_pid

select a.name_ as name, a.residential_address as residentialAddress, a.birthdate, a.identify_type as identifyType, a.identify_number as identifyNumber, a.pid as pid, b.pid as relId, b.rel_category as relCategory, b.rel_category_sub as relCategorySub, b.isValid as isValid, b.shareholding_ratio as shareholdingRatio, b.relStatement as relStatement from bus_rel_psn a join (select to_pid,to_name,rel_category,rel_category_sub,isValid,pid,shareholding_ratio,relStatement from bus_rel where from_pid = #{orgid} and from_type = 'ORG' and rel_status='00' and to_type = 'PSN' and (DELFLAG_ = '1')) b on a.pid = b.to_pid

select alig_code from bus_rel_psn where identify_number=#{psnIdentifyNumber};

select to_pid as toPid, from_pid as fromPid, rel_category as relCategory, rel_category_sub as relCategorySub, from_type as fromType, to_type as toType, relStatement as relStatement from bus_rel where to_pid=#{toPid};
mapper.update: update bus_rel_org set is_Iterate=#{isIterate} where pid=#{pid}
mapper.select: SELECT rel.mem_group FROM bus_rel_org rel WHERE 1=1 AND rel.unisc_code = #{relId}

SELECT sum( CASE WHEN isnull(funds.agreement_amount) || length(funds.agreement_amount) < 0 THEN 0 ELSE funds.agreement_amount END ) AS totalMount FROM bus_rel_org org INNER JOIN ins_tra_funds funds ON funds.REL_NUMBER = org.unisc_code WHERE 1=1 AND org.mem_group = #{memGroup} AND YEAR ( funds.CREATED_TIME_ ) = #{contractSigningDate} AND funds.STATUS IN ('2', '6')
select org_name,org_type,identify_type,unisc_code from bus_rel_org where 1=1 and effect_relation = '1' and DELFLAG_= '1' and (org_name not like '复星保德信人寿%' or org_name LIKE '复星保德信%工会%')
select * from bus_rel_org where 1=1 and identify_type = #{identify_type} and unisc_code = #{unisc_code}
select glfbh from bus_rel_org order by pid desc limit 1;

select org.PID as pid ,org.ORG_NAME as orgName ,rel.PID as relId ,rel.HOLDINGS as holdings,rel.REL_CATEGORY_SUB as relCategorySub from bus_rel as rel left join bus_rel_org as org on org.PID = rel.FROM_PID where rel.TO_PID = #{pid} and rel.DELFLAG_= '1';

select org.PID as pid ,org.ORG_NAME as orgName ,relPro.PID as relId ,relPro.HOLDINGS as holdings,relPro.REL_CATEGORY_SUB as relCategorySub from bus_rel as relPro left join bus_rel_org as org on org.PID = relPro.FROM_PID where relPro.TO_PID = #{pid} and relPro.DELFLAG_= '1';

select rel.FROM_PID, rel.TO_PID, org.ORG_NAME as orgName,rel.PID as relId ,rel.HOLDINGS as holdings,rel.REL_CATEGORY_SUB as relCategorySub from bus_rel rel left join bus_rel_org org on org.PID = rel.to_PID where rel.FROM_PID = #{pid} and rel.DELFLAG_= '1' ;

select org.PID as pid ,org.ORG_NAME as orgName,relPro.FROM_PID ,relPro.TO_PID,relPro.PID as relId ,relPro.HOLDINGS as holdings,relPro.REL_CATEGORY_SUB as relCategorySub from bus_rel relPro left join bus_rel_org org on org.PID = relPro.TO_PID where relPro.FROM_PID = #{pid} and relPro.DELFLAG_= '1';
SELECT distinct record_number FROM bus_rel_org WHERE record_number is NOT NULL and record_number like concat('%',#{param,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%') ORDER BY record_number DESC
